exposure.rationale: The frozen validity-v2 contract pins native MCP tools with Code Mode absent. Direct MCP is selected explicitly before certification; adding a Code Mode arm would change the treatment surface and is not compared in this development pilot.

holdout.rationale: Holdout cases are pinned and preflighted but not executed by the development pilot. They stay reserved for a later certification campaign and cannot reuse any development observation.

breadth.rationale: Breadth follows task ambiguity, semantic relationships, and measured baseline retrieval behavior. Material UI is retained as the larger external corpus because its baseline lexical searches produce more ambiguous matches than the smaller candidates without the disproportionate build cost of VS Code.

decisionPolicy.continue: Candidate meets the frozen cost and correctness gates; proceed to expose the exact artifact to certification after the budget is revised from the EVAL-035 sample-size result.
decisionPolicy.redesign: Corrected trajectories show a request-1 surface, index-contribution, authoritative-stop, or correctness defect.
decisionPolicy.narrowScope: No interface defect is observed but the candidate misses the frozen cost target; restrict the next claim to the classes and cases where the candidate adds value.
decisionPolicy.stop: Execution validity is incomplete, so no candidate-cost or correctness claim can be made.
